reason: No coupons and nothing for my counter staff to do, and the first month is free with STOP to cancel, so I'll try the ₹999 plan and check it against my sales book. I'm not touching the ₹2,499 creator plan until I see enquiries actually turn into bills.
objection: Views and followers don't pay rent. If the Sunday report can't show me how many WhatsApp enquiries became paying customers, I'm cancelling after the free month, and I don't trust an AI to write Kannada captions that sound like my place.
would_change_my_mind: If the free month doesn't bring at least a handful of WhatsApp enquiries I can match to real orders, I won't pay.
